title: One-component all-degrees Ext characterization
statement: For every commutative ring R, module X, and natural n, HasProjectiveResolutionLE X n is equivalent to vanishing of Ext in every degree i ≥ n + 1 against every module Y, using HasExt.standard: HasProjectiveResolutionLE X n ↔ ∀ Y i, n + 1 ≤ i → Subsingleton (Abelian.Ext X Y i).

proof.text: For the forward implication, from a resolution bounded by n, reuse the same resolution to obtain a bound i - 1 whenever n + 1 ≤ i; apply the degree characterization at i - 1 and rewrite i - 1 + 1 = i. For the reverse implication, specialize the all-degrees hypothesis to i = n + 1 and apply the reverse direction of the degree characterization.

proof_origin.place: reduction from all higher degrees to the degree n + 1 characterization

lean.statement: theorem projective_resolution_ext_all_degrees {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (n : ℕ) : (HasProjectiveResolutionLE X n ↔ ∀ (Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (i : ℕ), n + 1 ≤ i → Subsingleton (@Abelian.Ext _ _ _ (HasExt.standard (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)) X Y i))
